reproduction: guest-native-install-pi.ps1 wrote installer_started, command_exit with exit_code null, and installer_error PI_NPM_INSTALL_FAILED after npm stdout showed 119 packages added.
observation: The Guest installer process remained alive and native-install-status.json remained state=RUNNING with no finished_utc; the exception path did not produce a durable terminal state.
expected: Every failure path must write FAILED/timeout status and finished_utc before process exit, even if a step returned an unexpected null exit code.
impact: Host cannot safely decide when to remove the temporary NIC or harvest final installation status; a partial Pi installation exists and must be inspected without blind reinstall.
minimal_change: Make terminal status writing unconditional in a finally block, normalize null exit codes only after checking process completion, and separate step evidence from finalization errors.
rollback: Preserve current Guest logs and terminate only the exact stale installer process before the next run.
verification: A new run reaches terminal status on both success and failure, and Host collector can remove the temporary NIC only after that status.
unresolved_risk: The Pi package may already be installed; the next run must verify version/list before attempting another npm install.
